title: NPC数量过度增长导致人口膨胀
description: NPC数量随时间不断增长，导致游戏世界人口膨胀。
evidence: If your save had 300-320 NPCs on start - after a few days it would be a 370. Week later = 400... And a two-three weeks later = >500
